familyNotes.0x08000041: Dim orange-brown fireball puff (additive, alpha 1 everywhere; brightest texels only ~(0.37,0.15,0.03) linear, half the texels under 0.1). Used for nearly all retail fire: flaming-weapon flames, fire arrows, Flame Bolt / Ball of Fire bodies and impacts, breath fire, campfires, braziers, bonfires, fire elementals, eruptions. Erosion is OFF on every emitter: its 0.4-wide smoothstep window cut ~45% of this dim texture from birth and up to 95% by end-of-life (weapon flames would have been ~1/3 as visible). 'core' is a no-op here (no texel reaches 0.45), so heat comes from gain + tint0. The gen ramp (warm-white birth -> deep red death) is kept for normal fading puffs; trans 1->0 'condensing' emitters get their own ramps (projectile bodies heat up into the core, weapon/brazier tongues stay orange).
familyNotes.0x08000072: Grey additive smoke puff (neutral, brightest ~0.32 linear, p95 0.27, edge 0.2 so never spun): frost-weapon and frost-spell vapour (Frost weapons, BreatheFrost, Frost Bolt, Ice Golem, Chill/Flake/Frost elementals), scenery steam (geyser, steam vents, pools, mug), fog banks and the steam eruption. Erosion OFF everywhere (it removed ~64% of this dim texture at birth). Frost contexts get a subtle icy-blue tint and lit 0.45 (still reads at night); scenery steam/fog keep lit 0.75 and get real fade-ins on the huge billows.
familyNotes.0x080000E6: Dark grey alpha smoke puff (rgb ~0.19, alpha up to 0.98): fire smoke for weapons, arrows, braziers, forges, explosions, breath, plus shadow-creature auras and void-mage wisps. Alpha is high so generated erosion is safe (keeps ~90%); fixes are pop-ins on huge billows, a violet-dark tint for shadow/void auras, crisp dark drips, tiny-wisp soft/near values.
familyNotes.0x08000326: PURE BLACK dappled disc (rgb 0, alpha <=0.62, speckled) - re-filed smoke_light -> smoke_dark: black smoke/darkness puffs for Void Lord/Tenebrous/Penumbral auras, Shadow Bolt/Vortex/Eddy, SkillDownBlack, black-flame scenery and Branith's Staff, LevelUp dark motes, Nether Staff halo. Tint/gain/sat/lit are no-ops on black; only fades, erosion, spin, soft and nearFade matter. Steady respawning blobs get no fades/erosion; constant-opacity billows get real fades.
